requirements: docs/24 Sync model (checkpoint handoff bundles; one log)
scenarios: a local Core's task is parked, checkpointed and bundled; the bundle carries no secret value and names the forge token as a handle
the Cloud API refuses a bundle needing browser.control (CAPABILITY_PARITY), admits the real one, replays the admission

a worker materializes the continuation (bundle clone, checkpoint files, objects, rebind to cloud_isolated) and runs it inside a sandbox to READY_FOR_REVIEW with the laptop's transcript, edit and history
proof: ExportHandoff parks the run at its boundary, captures a checkpoint and writes events.jsonl, objects/, repo.bundle and manifest.json (capabilities, secret handles, checkpoint and git identity) — no secret value in any part; POST /v1/handoffs verifies capability parity, imports the log verbatim under the cloud tenant, stores the admitted manifest (bundle_hash) and journals TaskHandoffAdmitted; the worker materializes the worktree from the bundle and the checkpoint, imports the objects, rebinds the task to its workspace under cloud_isolated (the laptop's lease retired, the cloud profile's granted) and StartTask provisions the sandbox and resumes the run with the same transcript.
audit: MISSING before: StartCloudHandoff and /v1/handoffs were names only.
limitations: part-by-part upload; cloud_isolated only; nothing synced back to the laptop; fixed cloud capability set.
